title: Envoy ordered route list with overlaps (preserve order or refuse)
claims: a regex route listed before an overlapping prefix keeps precedence (/api/x.json to the regex cluster)
the prefix after it serves the rest (/api/x)
a broader prefix listed first shadows a later, more specific prefix (/legacy/v2/x stays on the first route)
not_claimed: RE2 vs Rust regex dialect differences beyond this simple pattern
source_semantics: Envoy evaluates a virtual host's routes in order and uses the first match; safe_regex matches the full path. Ferrum ranks exact > longest prefix > regex (docs/routing.md), which differs for both overlaps, so order must be preserved, shadowed routes dropped, or the overlap refused with a report error.
